description: This Scala source file defines the TaskResultGetter class responsible for managing a thread pool that deserializes and fetches task results in Apache Spark. It handles successful and failed task result processing, including remote fetches, deserialization, and task state updates.

classes.name: TaskResultGetter
classes.description: Manages a thread pool to deserialize and fetch task results, handling success, failure, and partition completion notifications.

methods.name: enqueueSuccessfulTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task result for processing, deserializing the result, handling indirect results, and updating task state.

methods.name: enqueueFailedTask
methods.description: Enqueues a failed task notification, deserializing the failure reason and updating task state accordingly.

methods.name: enqueuePartitionCompletionNotification
methods.description: Enqueues a notification that a partition has completed, calling the scheduler asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the thread pool used for task result processing.
